XECH-Pulse II Pen Stand & Smart Handset – Advanced Desk Companion

The XECH-Pulse II Pen Stand is a next-generation Pen Stand & Stationery Holder that seamlessly integrates a Smart Handset into your workspace. Designed for modern professionals, home offices, and smart desks, this innovative product combines utility, communication, and style in one compact solution. Built with precision engineering and premium materials, it enhances both productivity and desk aesthetics while delivering reliable wireless performance.

Unlike ordinary desk accessories, the XECH-Pulse II Pen Stand offers Radiation Reduction Technology that minimizes exposure during prolonged usage. This makes it a safer choice for daily calls, virtual meetings, and hands-free conversations. With advanced Wireless Transmission, users experience stable connectivity and crystal-clear audio, ensuring High-Quality Calls every time.

As a multifunctional it keeps your pens, markers, and desk essentials neatly organized, reducing clutter and improving efficiency. The integrated Smart Handset adds powerful calling and media control features without occupying extra desk space. Whether you are working, attending online meetings, or managing calls, the is optimized for convenience and performance.

Smart Features Designed for Everyday Productivity

The supports Dual Device Pairing, allowing you to connect two smartphones simultaneously. This feature is ideal for professionals who manage both personal and work devices. Switching between devices is seamless, ensuring uninterrupted workflow and efficient call handling.

Equipped with a built-in Selfie Remote, this smart desk accessory lets you capture photos and videos remotely, making it perfect for content creators, video calls, and presentations. The responsive Multimedia Buttons allow easy control of music, videos, and calls, while the dedicated Redial Function ensures quick reconnection to your last call.

For voice-first users, the is fully Optimized for Siri & Google Assistant. With a single touch, you can activate your preferred voice assistant to make calls, send messages, set reminders, or control smart devices. This hands-free functionality improves productivity and supports a smarter, more connected workspace.

Why Choose?

  • Innovative Pen Stand & Stationery Holder with integrated Smart Handset
  • Advanced Radiation Reduction Technology for safer daily communication
  • Stable Wireless Transmission with High-Quality Calls
  • Convenient Dual Device Pairing for work and personal phones
  • Built-in Selfie Remote for hands-free photos and videos
  • Easy control with responsive Multimedia Buttons
  • Quick access with dedicated Redial Function
  • Fully Optimized for Siri & Google Assistant
  • Modern design that complements home and office desks

Perfect for Home, Office, and Smart Workspaces

The is engineered for users who value organization, technology, and safety. Its compact form factor fits effortlessly on any desk, while its intelligent features transform it into more than just a stationery holder. From managing calls to controlling media and accessing voice assistants, this smart handset solution streamlines everyday tasks.

Whether you are a professional, student, or entrepreneur, the delivers a premium desk experience. With its balance of smart communication features and practical storage, it stands out as a must-have accessory for anyone looking to upgrade their workspace with a reliable, future-ready solution.
